meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 会增加一个 Emacs 通道。你可以在 Emacs 里打开聊天窗口和它对话，也能把 org 文档里的内容发给它，回复会作为子标题插回文档。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 里用快捷键（如 `C-c n c`）打开聊天窗口发送消息，或对 org 内容执行发送命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我看下这段代码怎么优化？
say.note: 回复会出现在聊天 buffer 里。

say.text: 把选中的三段总结成要点。
say.note: 回复作为子标题插入 org 文件。

say.text: 根据这条议程列出行动项。

howto.what_en: Adds an Emacs channel to NanoClaw. You can open a chat buffer inside Emacs and talk to the agent, or send org-mode content and get the reply inserted as a child heading.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you open the chat buffer from Emacs (e.g. C-c n c) and send a message, or when you run the org send command on a region or subtree.

say_en.text: Can you help me optimize this code?
say_en.note: Reply appears in the chat buffer.

say_en.text: Summarize the selected three paragraphs into bullet points.
say_en.note: Reply is inserted as a child heading in the org file.

say_en.text: List action items from this agenda entry.
say_en.note: Same as above, generated inside org.
